claim: Former Secretary of State Madeleine Albright was a speaker at a special conference that commemorated the 25th anniversary of the Velvet Revolution and its key figure, Václav Havel.

evidence.quote: A special conference commemorated the 25th anniversary of the Velvet Revolution and its key figure, Václav Havel, who later became president of Czechoslovakia and the Czech Republic. Speakers included Michael Zantovsky, former Secretary of State Madeleine Albright and Sen. John McCain.
Recorded on 2014-11-19.

Senator John McCain and former Secretary of State Madeleine Albright join former Ambassador of the Czech Republic to the United Kingdom Michael Žantovský in a discussion on the political importance of Václav Havel, November 19, 2014.
Library of Congress

notes: Conference held by the John W. Kluge Center.
